flows.title: Search prospects with filters
steps: From the Workspace home screen, accessible via Create new in the left navigation, click "Filter contacts" to search for people, or "Filter companies" to search for organizations.
Choose from filter categories such as job title, seniority, department, industry, location, or company size; results appear instantly in the table on the right.
Click "Save first X contacts" (50, 150, 500, or 1,000) to convert the preview into a permanent Workspace table.

flows.title: Reveal a contact's email or phone
steps: Find a cell showing masked data (dots) and click "Show" to reveal the email address or phone number.
Or click "Show details" on a contact's row to open a detail panel showing all available data for that record, including phone numbers, email addresses, LinkedIn profile, and company information.

flows.title: Export contacts to CSV
steps: Open a saved Workspace table (if you're in a search or filter view, save it as a table first).
Select the contacts you want to export using the row checkboxes, or use the header checkbox to select all rows on the page, a custom amount, or all rows matching your active filters.
Click the CSV button in the toolbar.
In the dialog, choose a scope: "Selected rows only", "Current page", or "All rows (including filtered)".
